name: Strange!
source:
Hinata is you average schoolgirl. One day while dozing off in the middle of class…she wakes up to a strange unfamiliar man standing in front of her, referring to her as his 'wife'. Sufficiently freaked, she runs away only to soon realize she's traveled to some parallel universe!

What now…?

[from [url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/07/26/otome-game-review-babyclan-special/]Koorin's review[/url]]
translation:
日向是一个普通的女学生。某天上课时打瞌睡……醒来时发现一个陌生的奇怪男人站在她面前，称她为“妻子”。吓得够呛的她跑开了，却很快意识到自己穿越到了某个平行宇宙！

这下怎么办……？

[来自[url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/07/26/otome-game-review-babyclan-special/]Koorin的评测[/url]]
